originalTitle: Education Department extends deadline for student loan interest rate discount
summary: The Trump administration announced it will extend the deadline for federal student loan borrowers to sign up for autopay and get a reduced interest rate.
content:
The Trump administration announced on Tuesday that it will extend the deadline for federal student loan borrowers to get a reduction of 1 percentage point on their interest rate.

Once borrowers enroll, the benefit will last through June 30, 2028.

Nearly 2 million federal student loan borrowers have signed up for autopay since the discount became available over the summer, the department said.

Typically, borrowers on autopay have had access to a 0.25 percentage point discount.

More than 42 million Americans carry student loans, and the outstanding debt exceeds $1.7 trillion. The current average interest rate on federal student loans is 6.54%, according to higher education expert Mark Kantrowitz.

To qualify for the interest rate discount, your debt must be from the Direct Loan program, Kantrowitz said. That includes Direct Subsidized Loans, Direct Unsubsidized Loans, Direct PLUS Loans and Direct Consolidation Loans. Parent PLUS borrowers will also be eligible, as long as their loans are from the Direct Loan program, he said.

Federal Family Education Loans, or FFEL, aren't eligible for the temporary reduced rate. As the federal government is offering the discount, the benefit does not extend to private student loans.

In addition, your loans must have been disbursed on or after July 1, 2012, Kantrowitz said. You can find your loan disbursement dates at Studentaid.gov or with your servicer. Your loans must also be in good standing to qualify.

Student loan borrowers can enroll in automatic payments through their loan servicer's website, said Scott Buchanan, executive director of the Student Loan Servicing Alliance, a trade group for federal student loan servicers. He said to look for a tab labeled "manage payments" or something similar.

You'll typically need to provide your bank account number and a few other details, but it's quick to submit a request, Buchanan said: "It takes a minute."

If you don't know which company is managing your student loans on behalf of the Education Department, or need the company's contact information, you can get that information from StudentAid.gov .
chineseTitle: 教育部延长学生贷款利率折扣期限
chineseSummary: 特朗普政府宣布将延长联邦学生贷款借款人注册自动转账并获得降低利率的最后期限。
chineseContent:
特朗普政府周二宣布，将延长联邦学生贷款借款人利率降低 1 个百分点的最后期限。

借款人注册后，该福利将持续到 2028 年 6 月 30 日。

该部门表示，自夏季推出折扣以来，已有近 200 万联邦学生贷款借款人签署了自动转账协议。

通常情况下，使用自动转账的借款人可以获得 0.25 个百分点的折扣。

超过 4200 万美国人持有学生贷款，未偿债务超过 1.7 万亿美元。高等教育专家 Mark Kantrowitz 表示，目前联邦学生贷款的平均利率为 6.54%。

坎特罗维茨说，为了有资格获得利率折扣，你的债务必须来自直接贷款计划。这包括直接补贴贷款、直接无补贴贷款、直接加贷款和直接合并贷款。他说，只要贷款来自直接贷款计划，家长加借款人也将符合资格。

联邦家庭教育贷款 (FFEL) 不符合临时降低利率的条件。由于联邦政府提供折扣，因此该优惠不适用于私人学生贷款。

此外，您的贷款必须在 2012 年 7 月 1 日或之后支付，Kantrowitz 说。您可以在 Studentaid.gov 或向您的服务机构查找您的贷款支付日期。您的贷款还必须信誉良好才有资格。

联邦学生贷款服务商贸易组织学生贷款服务联盟执行董事斯科特·布坎南(Scott Buchanan)表示，学生贷款借款人可以通过贷款服务商的网站注册自动付款。他说寻找标有“管理付款”或类似内容的标签。

您通常需要提供您的银行帐号和一些其他详细信息，但提交请求很快，布坎南说：“需要一分钟的时间。”

如果您不知道哪家公司代表教育部管理您的学生贷款，或者需要该公司的联系信息，您可以从 StudentAid.gov 获取该信息。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
